pageProps.content: ## Ordered ```menu { "title": "pistachio", "rating": 4.5 } --- Rich and nutty pistachio. The textbook taste of Italian gelato. ``` ```menu { "title": "hazelnut", "rating": 3.5 } --- Smooth and fragrant hazelnut. The nutty aroma came through beautifully. ``` ```menu { "title": "chocolate", "rating": 3.5 } --- Deep, intense chocolate flavor like Godiva. A bit too sweet for me. ``` ## Review A famous gelato shop in Melbourne. If you have the time, it's definitely worth a visit. ```adcard ``` There was a queue but it moved faster than expected. We ordered a cone with 2 flavors mixed together. The portion was bigger than expected — honestly, one scoop would have been enough. Two scoops was too sweet for me. It was the first time I've ever felt genuinely full from eating gelato. ## Pictures
